items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: Sean and I was in the hall.

ctx.x: I was gonna ask you about the advertising job. You say you played advertising jobs. Who did you play? What band did you play with?

Oh we played with the live advertising. It was funny. Then I played with different bands. I played live advertising for dances. That was Bob Lyons band. You played with Bob Lyons band. Oh yeah. Well I wouldn't say like it was regular. But just like you say you played, you played with him maybe like this Saturday, maybe Saturday and Sunday. You know? Sure. You played with the live advertising. Bob Lyons band. We played a lot of advertising with him and for him. He and Rainey at the time used to have the real…
Where did you sit in the truck when you were playing drums?
